Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the clear notes and for sending the questionnaire. Quick post-call recap and answers to your questions: 

1) SOC 2: Redwood is undergoing SOC 2 Type II and we expect completion of the current audit on or around 2027-05-31. We can provide the SOC 2 report as soon as it's available; in the meantime we can provide our SOC 2 controls matrix and third-party attestation letter.

2) HIPAA / BAA: Redwood supports HIPAA-covered workloads for Dedicated or Private deployments. For our Hosted API we provide additional contractual and technical safeguards but we typically execute a BAA when customers run PHI on Dedicated or Private. If Acme intends to process PHI on Hosted, we'll need to scope specific controls and legal review.

3) DPA & SCC: Since Acme will be the controller and Redwood the processor, the appropriate EU SCC set is Module Two (controller-to-processor). We typically propose the standard EU SCC Module Two annex, plus our DPA (I attached a working draft).

4) Questionnaire process: we normally do a questionnaire-first intake (security team reviews the questionnaire) and then proceed with the DPA/SCC redlines. Please send the questionnaire back to security@redwood.com; I'm cc'ing Rishi (sales/AM) and Neha (CS/security coordination) to help track.

Proposed next steps:
- I'll send the draft DPA + SCC Module Two annex for ACME review (attached).
- Our security team will start answering the vendor questionnaire and return a completed copy within 3 business days.
- If Acme needs a BAA for PHI, we'll route to legal and propose Dedicated/Private scoping and a BAA template.

Attaching: DPA_draft_v2.pdf; SCC_module_selection_notes.docx

Would you be available for a short sync with legal (30 min) on Friday to align on contract and PHI scoping?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Sofia —

Thanks — quick answers inline and next steps: 

- BAA: Redwood can sign a BAA for Dedicated or Private deployments where we are acting as a HIPAA-covered service provider. We'll include the BAA template with the DPA package. For Hosted customers that require PHI, we'll need a legal assessment; we can discuss case-by-case.

- Data residency: Yes — Dedicated and Private deployments can be provisioned in the EU region to meet residency requirements. We'll include region and isolation options in the DPA/operational appendix.

- SCC: We'll proceed with Module Two (controller-to-processor) as the primary annex. Our legal team prefers to start with Module Two + redlines.

I've attached an updated DPA (DPA_draft_v2.pdf) and our SCC selection notes. Next steps from Redwood:
1) Security team will start answering your vendor questionnaire and return the completed doc within 3 business days.
2) Legal will prepare DPA + SCC Module Two + BAA template and share via DocuSign for signature.
3) Let's schedule a 30-min legal sync this Friday, 2027-04-02 or Monday 2027-04-05 — what works for your legal team?

Cc'ing Rishi and Neha so procurement and CS are looped in.
\Best,
Marissa
